Garage – S3-compatible object storage plus its web admin panel, one container

Object storage with its own garage door opener.

   

What is this?

Garage is a lightweight, S3-API-compatible object store built for small, self-hosted deployments (Rust, Apache-2.0, actively developed). Garage's own Community Applications listings are split across three separate templates from another maintainer — the core server in two network variants, plus the admin panel as its own install. This template bundles the core server and garage-webui (its web admin panel) into one container — both official, unmodified upstream binaries, wired together with s6-overlay. Zero manual CLI setup: the single-node cluster layout, an S3 access key, secret key and bucket are all created automatically on first boot.

Highlights

  • One container instead of three — core server + admin panel, no separate installs to keep in sync
  • Zero-CLI first boot — single-node layout auto-created (Garage's own --single-node, v2.3.0+); an S3 access key, secret key and bucket are pre-seeded from the template fields, no garage layout assign / garage key create / garage bucket create needed
  • garage-webui built in — buckets, keys and cluster health are all browsable, no terminal needed
  • Official, unmodified binaries — both Garage and garage-webui are pulled straight from their upstream images, not rebuilt or patched
  • Only the S3 API (3900), S3 website (3902, optional) and admin panel (3909) are published — the internal RPC and admin-API ports stay off the network
  • Multi-arch — amd64 + arm64
  • Image: ghcr.io/junkerderprovinz/garage:latest (also mirrored to Docker Hub)

Requirements

  • Unraid 6.10+
  • Map both the Data and Config volumes — Config holds the generated garage.toml (RPC secret, admin token). Losing it regenerates those secrets on next boot and breaks the admin panel's session.
  • Set an Access Key and Secret Key in the template before storing anything real

Posting a bug report

Please post:

  • Unraid version (Settings → System Information)
  • Image tag (latest or a pinned vX.Y.Z)
  • Output of docker logs --tail 200 garage
  • Whether you changed the DB Engine (sqlite/lmdb), or the /data / /config mounts

GitHub issues with the same info are also welcome: github.com/junkerderprovinz/garage/issues
